title: Partition flips and noise sensitivity
statement: Let $m\geq 1$, choose an index $j\in\{1,\ldots,m\}$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. Choose a map from the $n$ coordinates to $m$ labels uniformly at random, and independently choose $x$ uniformly from the sign cube. The probability that $f(x)$ changes when the signs at coordinates assigned label $j$ are flipped, averaged over both choices, equals the noise sensitivity of $f$ at noise rate $1/m$.
hypotheses_covered: $j$ is an index among the $m$ labels
